title: Ventilation, MVHR & FCUs
activity: Ductwork, MVHR units, FCUs and grilles
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Is ductwork installed and supported to B&ES DW/144, joints sealed, with no crushed flex?
Are fire dampers or sleeves fitted where ducts cross fire-rated walls, with access to them?
Are FCU/MVHR units level and supported, with condensate drain falls and filter access clear?
Are grilles in the right positions, square and undamaged?
Are air flows commissioned and recorded (CIBSE Code A)?
